a large farm building for storing hay or housing animals

a person who dances

truthfulness

baby

dried stalks of grain; a thin tube for drinking

a sudden, jarring blow; a protuberance

a strong open vehicle with two or four wheels, typically used for transport

a traveling company of acrobats, clowns, and other entertainers

a game or problem
